caption: The drawing features a single, round, dark-colored object that appears to be a shallow dish or bowl, viewed from above. The dish has concentric circular designs on its surface, indicated through shading. Attached to the top of the bowl is an ornate, decorative handle or crest, which has a symmetrical design incorporating curved, organic shapes that may resemble leaves or scrollwork, and a central rectangular slot. The composition of the drawing is centered, with the bowl and handle placed squarely in the middle of a lightly outlined rectangular frame. In the upper left corner, there is a small, separate inset diagram showing a side-view cross-section of the handle with dimensions marked. The entire drawing is executed in shades of black and gray pencil on a beige or off-white background. The artist's signature, "Eugene J. Bassett," is written at the lower right corner of the inner rectangular frame.
title: Pewter Porringer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
